'''Nilluk strips''' were a food cooked by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and served during breakfast. Rodian merchant [[Teeloo]] cooked it for breakfast for him and his friend before racing through [[Eskaron]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].
